metadata.summary: This time-limited state plan amendment responds to the COVID-19 national emergency. The purpose of this amendment is to add the COVID-19 testing group under 1902(a)(10)(A)(ii)(XXIII) of the Act; Allow individuals who are evacuated from the state, who leave the state for medical reasons related to the disaster or public health emergency, or who are otherwise absent from the state due to the disaster or public health emergency and who intend to return to the state continue to be residents of the state under 42 CFR 435.403(j)(3); Implement lab benefit flexibilities under 42 CFR 440.30(a) and 42 CFR 440.30(b); and Allow for 100 percent Medicaid reimbursement in accordance with Medicare reimbursement for COVID-19 laboratory testing procedure codes.
metadata.title: Nevada Medicaid SPA NV-20-0009: Approval Document (approved June 18, 2020, effective March 1, 2020)
